title: Red-Green Towers
statementMd:
There are $*r*$ red and $*g*$ green blocks for construction of the *red-green* tower. *Red-green* tower can be built following next rules:

- Red-green tower is consisting of some number of levels;
- Let the red-green tower consist of $*n*$ levels, then the first level of this tower should consist of $*n*$ blocks, second level — of $*n* - 1$ blocks, the third one — of $*n* - 2$ blocks, and so on — the last level of such tower should consist of the one block. In other words, each successive level should contain one block less than the previous one;
- Each level of the red-green tower should contain blocks of the same color.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8832fa6ce563690d8fee41a42741636a388d24c.png)

Let $*h*$ be the maximum possible number of levels of red-green tower, that can be built out of $*r*$ red and $*g*$ green blocks meeting the rules above. The task is to determine how many different red-green towers having $*h*$ levels can be built out of the available blocks.

Two red-green towers are considered different if there exists some level, that consists of red blocks in the one tower and consists of green blocks in the other tower.

You are to write a program that will find the number of different red-green towers of height $*h*$ modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Input

The only line of input contains two integers $*r*$ and $*g*$, separated by a single space — the number of available red and green blocks respectively ($0 ≤ *r*, *g* ≤ 2·10^{5}$, $*r* + *g* ≥ 1$).

## Output

Output the only integer — the number of different possible red-green towers of height $*h*$ modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Note

The image in the problem statement shows all possible red-green towers for the first sample.
statementZhMd:
有 $*r*$ 个红色方块和 $*g*$ 个绿色方块，用于建造一座*红绿*塔。*红绿*塔可以按照以下规则建造：

- 红绿塔由若干层组成；
- 设红绿塔由 $*n*$ 层组成，则该塔的第一层应由 $*n*$ 个方块组成，第二层由 $*n* - 1$ 个方块组成，第三层由 $*n* - 2$ 个方块组成，以此类推——这样的塔的最后一层应由 1 个方块组成。换句话说，每一层应比上一层少一个方块；
- 红绿塔的每一层都应由同一种颜色的方块组成。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8832fa6ce563690d8fee41a42741636a388d24c.png)

设 $*h*$ 是使用 $*r*$ 个红色方块和 $*g*$ 个绿色方块，并满足上述规则时，能够建造的红绿塔的最大层数。任务是确定使用现有方块能够建造多少种具有 $*h*$ 层的不同红绿塔。

如果存在某一层，在一座塔中由红色方块组成，而在另一座塔中由绿色方块组成，则认为这两座红绿塔不同。

请编写程序，求出层数为 $*h*$ 的不同红绿塔数量，结果对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含两个由一个空格分隔的整数 $*r*$ 和 $*g*$，分别表示可用的红色方块和绿色方块的数量（$0 ≤ *r*, *g*≤2·10^{5}$，$*r* + *g* ≥ 1$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即层数为 $*h*$ 的不同红绿塔数量，结果对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模。

## 说明

题面中的图片展示了第一个样例的所有可能的红绿塔。
